subject: Request to move live demo to allow extended prep for sample data and workload traces
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercado <a.mercado@acme.com>, acme-it <it@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Live demo - Thurs Dec 2 (proposed) + sample data

Vanessa / team,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the proposal. Our leadership asked us to move quickly and we'd like to schedule the live demo for Thu, Dec 2 at 11:00 AM PT if that still works for your engineers. Two quick notes from our side: 

- We want the demo to run against a small sample of our production traces (anonymized) so we can validate latency and output quality.
- We need at least one hour of prep with your ops to get an S3 upload and a short workload trace ingestion validated.

Can you confirm if Dec 2 11:00 AM PT is feasible and whether your team can support the ingest windows tomorrow morning (Dec 1) for a dry-run? If there's a preferred manifest format, please send it and we'll get our infra to upload ASAP.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Director, Product 
Acme Corp
[Attachment: acme_sample_manifest.csv (CSV, 6KB)]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo - Thurs Dec 2 (proposed) + sample data

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and for sending the manifest. Quick internal check: we have a couple of constraints that make Dec 2 at 11:00 difficult to support as a full production-like demo:

1) Key engineering leads are traveling on Dec 2 for an offsite and won't be available for the live troubleshooting window.
2) Our infra team needs a minimum 24–48 hour runway to validate traces against the runtime (sequence length distribution + KV cache warmup) for anything beyond trivial sample inputs.

Proposed options that would keep quality high:
- Move the live demo to Wed Dec 8 or Thu Dec 9 (slots between 10:00–14:00 PT).
- In the meantime, we can run a focused dry-run on Thu Dec 2 at 10:00 AM PT that exercises the ingest pipeline (no leadership present) to validate the S3 path and sample manifest. That dry-run should be ~30–45 minutes.

Action items for your team if you agree:
- Upload a 50–200-row anonymized trace sample to the S3 path in the manifest (see attached template).
- Confirm who from your infra will own the upload (name + email).
- If you want the demo to run against more representative workloads, send a fuller workload trace by end of day Dec 2 so we can complete validation before the proposed Dec 8 slot.

I've attached our mutual action plan template (MAP_template.xlsx) and the demo readiness checklist so you can see the gating items. Connor will coordinate the dry-run; Marissa will lead the demo runbook on the day-of.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
[Attachment: MAP_template.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)]
From: Alex Mercado <a.mercado@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, acme-it <it@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo - Thurs Dec 2 (proposed) + sample data

Vanessa / team — appreciate the flexibility. Quick update from our side: leadership has a mandatory offsite on Dec 2 and several engineers we've planned to have in the demo are traveling. We can do the dry-run on Dec 2 as you suggested (10:00 AM PT) but we need the full, leadership-facing demo to be later.

Dec 8 at 11:00 AM PT looks good for us. We'll aim to have an expanded workload trace uploaded by EOD Dec 2 (we'll confirm upload status during the dry-run). Our DevOps lead (Sanjay Patel — sanjay.patel@acme.com) will own the S3 upload and be on the dry-run call.

Two questions: 
1) Do you have a short checklist (ops + security items) we should verify before the dry-run?
2) Will the Dec 8 slot include a brief post-demo Q&A with product/architecture?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Mercado
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercado <a.mercado@acme.com>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo - Thurs Dec 2 (proposed) + sample data

Perfect — thanks for the quick responses and for assigning Sanjay. Confirming the plan below (so everyone is aligned):

- Thu Dec 2, 10:00 AM PT: 30–45 minute dry-run focused on S3 ingest and manifest validation. Attendees: Sanjay (Acme DevOps), Connor (Redwood ops), Marissa (Redwood CS).
- Wed Dec 8, 11:00 AM PT: Leadership-facing live demo (60 minutes) + 15 minute Q&A. Attendees: Acme execs + Redwood product/architect + Marissa for outcomes and next steps.

Pre-dry-run checklist (short):
- Upload anonymized sample manifest to the S3 path in the manifest and confirm object ACLs (Sanju will confirm).
- Share a short README in the same folder describing field mappings and sequence length expectations.
- Confirm timeouts/sequence length target in the MAP file so we can pre-select kernels and batching profile.

Attachments: demo_readiness_checklist.pdf (contains the above and the runbook outline). Marissa — would you please take the lead on the runbook for Dec 8 and own the post-demo success criteria? Connor, can you confirm the dry-run dial-in and provide the minimal logs we need to watch during ingest?

Jordan / Alex — if you can confirm Sanjay's upload and drop a calendar accept for both events, we'll mark these as confirmed. Looking forward to a smooth run.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: demo_readiness_checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
